chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Southern one-nighters, Oklahoma City and Kansas City dates
summary: Tours through Mississippi, a long stay at the Ritz in Oklahoma City, two weeks at El Torreon in Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I was looking through all the different notes and stuff that I have, you guys had gone on tour, you'd gone through all of the south. You played Mississippi, you played in Jackson, Mississippi, I know.
We played all over, we played Natchez--
You also played in New Orleans?
You didn't? You're sure you never played New Orleans?
No, we didn't play Florida either.
I never played New Orleans until I was with Louis Armstrong.
You did play in the Ritz Ballroom, Oklahoma City.
You played there about three months.
Yeah, we were there a long time.
You also played at El Torea in Kansas City.
That was what, about a week?
We played there for two weeks, then we played a one nighter for colored on Paseo.
That's the time--this is about '30, '31, '32 maybe?
